recommendation: Keep the fix as-is. It completes the applied Security WG decision in the authoritative current build inputs. FHIR-53783 does not need a separate reconcile decision here because its correction example already existed and was only adjusted to satisfy FHIR-53917's removal/replace rule.
issue_request: FHIR-53917 was Applied/Not Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Provenance. It asked to address Provenance for resource removals without relaxing Provenance.target: removals should be indicated in both Provenance.target and Provenance.entity.what, an invariant should enforce that relationship, target wording should include removals, and delete/replace examples should demonstrate the rule.
initial_application: HL7/fhir#4028, merged as 66cbbee5f9e678f6c702807682f9bf0a064e9456, partially applied the issue. Commit bb74e6feffedb048c2a7339e6203b7d2201b10fa renamed the removal section and changed the delete example entity role to removal, and later PR commits added a correction replacement example and list entry. The active Provenance StructureDefinition still described target as generated or updated only, no approved invariant existed, and the replacement example targeted only the replacement resource.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread explains why the final resolution kept removed resources in target: participants objected to losing target as the affected-resource search surface for deletes. The Security WGM Confluence page records FHIR-53917 as resolved. source/fhir.ini actively lists provenance=Provenance, and the Provenance core IG references the relevant-history profile, so the edited conformance, narrative, examples, mapping-exception, and profile sources are in current build scope. Later Provenance wording reconciliations on the combined branch do not conflict with this rule.
reconciliation: Updated source/provenance/structuredefinition-Provenance.xml so Provenance.target includes generated, updated, or removed resources; added prov-5 requiring every removal entity what.reference to also appear in target.reference; aligned adjacent patient wording and the W3C map; added a negative invariant test; updated the correction replacement example to target both removed and replacement resources; pointed the removal guidance at prov-5; and updated the active relevant-history profile and mapping-exception source to stop describing target/history as create/update only.
source_changes: source/provenance/structuredefinition-Provenance.xml: updated Provenance.target, added prov-5, and aligned adjacent target/patient/W3C wording.
source/provenance/provenance-example-correction-replacement.xml: added the removed Immunization as a target alongside the replacement Immunization.
source/provenance/provenance-notes.xml: points removal guidance at the new prov-5 invariant.
source/provenance/structuredefinition-profile-provenance-relevant-history.xml: updated relevant-history target definition to include created, revised, or deleted history actions.
source/provenance/provenance-event-mapping-exceptions.xml: aligned generated/updated patient wording with created, updated, or removed target semantics.
source/provenance/invariant-tests/prov-5.f1.fail.xml: added a negative invariant test for removal entity references missing from target.
